0013:         self.assertTrue(registry_path.exists(), "commons capability registry must exist")
0014:

0016:         capabilities = registry["capabilities"]
0017:         self.assertEqual(len(capabilities), 5)
0018: 
0019:         kernel_contracts = {
0020:             definition.contract_id
0021:             for definition in KernelBootstrap.start().contracts.known_contracts()
0022:         }
0023: 
0024:         for item in capabilities:
0025:             capability_dir = commons_root / item["directory"]
0026:             manifest_path = capability_dir / "CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.json"
0027:             self.assertTrue(manifest_path.exists(), f"manifest missing for {item['directory']}")
0028: 
0029:             manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
0030:             self.assertEqual(manifest["capability_id"], item["capability_id"])

0032:             self.assertIn("state_authority", manifest)
0033:             self.assertIn("lifecycle", manifest)
0034:             self.assertIn("contract_bindings", manifest)
0035:             self.assertIn("packaging", manifest)
0036: 
0037:             for binding in manifest["contract_bindings"]:
0038:                 if binding["status"] == "registered":
0039:                     self.assertIn(
0040:                         binding["contract_id"],
0041:                         kernel_contracts,
